subject: Request: HelioThera exception for concierge credits & integration scope
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: HelioThera implementation credits & custom integration scope

Kimberly / Rishi —

Quick summary for context: HelioThera (medical devices, mid-market customer) is on a 3-year contract request. Net new ARR ~ $420k annually if we close; they want Redwood to include a premium onboarding bundle (concierge/white-glove) and a custom connector to their internal ERP for trial data ingestion.

Commercial ask:
- 30% first-year discount off list for the hosted inference usage (list > our standard is 20% max)
- Include 120 hours of professional services (developer & SE time) as part of Year 1 (no separate PS charge)
- Premium onboarding (concierge) included for Year 1 (standard upgrade is add-on)

Why this matters: HelioThera is evaluating consolidation across multiple hospital customers; they are PRIMED to upsell across 8 hospital systems in our next 18 months. Referenceable in med-dev vertical; procurement is pushing for a single-vendor solution.

Attachments: SOW_HelioThera_draft_v2.pdf (proposed scope), pricing_breakdown.xlsx

Ask: I know this goes beyond standard thresholds (discount >25% and PS hours > 80). Requesting deal-desk approval + exec sign-off for the concession. Recommended guardrails if approved: cap credits to 80 hours now and offer an option to purchase remaining hours at 50% discount; require milestone-based payments (30/40/30) and a signed SOW prior to kick-off.

Happy to jump on a quick call — they are pushing for an answer by Monday 8/16.

—Dylan
Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: HelioThera implementation credits & custom integration scope

Thanks for the write-up, Dylan. Saw the SOW and pricing sheet. A couple of quick notes from deal desk:

- Concessions requested exceed standard authority: discounts >25% require Director+ sign-off; PS credits >80 hours require exec approval (VP/GM).
- We need validated ARR and procurement timeline. Also need to confirm whether HelioThera will sign a 3-year term (we get better economics with term length).
- Security/compliance ask: they requested us to complete their security questionnaire and to sign an incoming-data Addendum. That will add ~5 business days for legal review.

If you can provide:
1) A short one-pager with net ARR and logo reference importance;
2) Procurement PO timeline (expected by when);
3) Final SOW with milestones and acceptance criteria — I can present to Markus for approval.

I recommend we propose the following conservative concession: 20% first-year discount, 80 hours concierge credit, and include the connector at a reduced PS rate (not fully free). If marketing/SE can push reference commitment from HelioThera, we could flex further.

Rishi
Deal Desk Lead
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: HelioThera — request for non-standard PS credit & discount

Markus — forwarding for quick exec sign-off.

Why I recommend approval: HelioThera is strategically aligned with our healthcare focus and has fast follow-on potential across hospital groups; marketing already volunteered to take a case study. The sales math shows lifetime value well above the concession cost if they expand to the expected footprint.

Recommended approval terms (my suggestion):
- Approve up to 20% first-year discount (not 30%).
- Approve 80 hours of concierge/PS credit included in Year 1; any additional custom connector work billed at 50% of list rate.
- Require SOW with milestones and acceptance criteria and a PO signed before we commence any work.
- Require legal sign-off on data ingress addendum and security questionnaire completion.

Budget impact: this can be absorbed within Q3 deal-desk concession buffer (we have ~ $75k headroom).

Markus — please reply with OK / OK with edits / reject. If OK, Rishi will prepare redline language and Dylan will communicate to Helio.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: HelioThera — request for non-standard PS credit & discount

Kimberly — thanks for the summary and recommendation. I'm comfortable approving with the conditions you proposed, plus the following guardrails:

- Cap the concession financial exposure to $48k total (inclusive of PS credits + discount impact).
- Approve 20% first-year discount and up to 80 PS hours as credit. Any PS beyond 80 hours must be pre-approved by me and documented in the SOW as billable at the discounted rate.
- Legal must sign the data ingress addendum and confirm the security questionnaire answers are acceptable. No work starts without a PO and signed SOW.
- Rishi: please document the concession in the deal record and mark it as an exec-approved one-time concession (reason: strategic healthcare reference).

If those conditions are OK, please proceed to finalize the offer and execute DocuSign.

- Markus
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lane <sara.lane@heliothera.com>, procurement@heliothera.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Mike Legal <mike.legal@heliothera.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: HelioThera: Revised commercial offer and next steps (DocuSign link included)

Sara / HelioThera team — thanks for the productive discussion this week. Per internal approvals, please find the revised commercial offer below and attached: SOW_HelioThera_draft_v2.pdf (updated), security_questionnaire_filled.pdf, pricing_breakdown.xlsx.

Key commercial terms (approved):
- Contract term: 36 months
- Year 1: 20% discount off hosted usage list pricing
- Concierge / premium onboarding: 80 hours of credited PS in Year 1 (applied to onboarding and connector build)
- Any additional custom connector work beyond 80 hours billed at 50% of our standard PS rate per the SOW
- Concession cap: maximum concession value not to exceed $48,000 (inclusive of discount impact and credits)
- Milestones: 30% upon contract signature, 40% at data ingestion acceptance, 30% at final production rollout (detailed in SOW)

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached SOW and security questionnaire.
2) Legal: confirm acceptance of the data ingress addendum and sign-off.
3) Procurement: provide PO and expected issue date.
4) Sign offer via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/xyz-helio-offer

On Mon, 15 Aug 2027 09:00:00 -0700, Markus Klein wrote:
> Kimberly — thanks for the summary and recommendation. I'm comfortable approving with the conditions you proposed...

If you need any clarifications I can hop on a call. Appreciate the fast turnaround — they wanted a yes/no this week.

–Dylan
Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
